sessionTitle: Build modern .NET apps with Uno Platform, AI, and visual tools

announcements.name: Uno Platform Studio AI and design tools
announcements.shortDescription: A collection of productivity tools layered on the Uno Platform foundation, including the Hot Design runtime visual designer and a custom AI agent.
announcements.longDescription: Uno Platform Studio is a collection of AI and design tools built on top of the Uno Platform foundation, meant to supercharge developer productivity. It includes Hot Design, a runtime visual designer for cross-platform .NET apps that provides a design canvas to tweak UI while the app is running, plus a custom AI agent to build UI. With Hot Reload, the running app, design surface, and code in the IDE all stay in sync.

announcements.name: Two built-in MCP servers
announcements.shortDescription: Uno MCP grounds AI agents in current documentation, while Uno App MCP gives agents "eyes and hands" to screenshot, click, and validate running app UI.
announcements.longDescription: Uno Platform offers two MCP servers out of the box, wired up automatically via an mcp.json file when a Uno Platform project is detected. The first, Uno MCP, brings the context of the latest documentation to the AI agent so it can search, fetch pages, summarize, and initialize with best practices. The second, Uno App MCP, gives AI agents "eyes and hands"—described as Playwright for cross-platform .NET apps—so the agent can screenshot, click, inspect the visual tree, paste text, and key press to validate the running app's UI.

announcements.name: Teased Build theater session with partner Kahua
announcements.shortDescription: A live joint session promising a "very big announcement and a surprise," plus an Expo booth presence.
announcements.longDescription: Sam Basu extends an open invitation to a live Microsoft Build theater session featuring Uno Platform and partner Kahua onstage together, where they will show more of what was previewed. He teases a "very big announcement and a surprise" waiting on the cards. He also mentions a booth presence in the Expo area where attendees can discuss the latest tech, AI, and grab swag.
